secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret used to sign JWT auth tokens. Auto-generated for development; replace with a strong random string for production.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google OAuth 2.0 Client ID for Google Sign-In. Create one at https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials (OAuth client → Web application). Add the preview origin as an Authorized JavaScript origin. Optional — the app works without it (email/password auth only).
